message: Codex implemented context-collector.ts (6.6 KB) and context-collector.test.ts (6.9 KB) with all 5 required exports and dependency-free Bun.spawnSync shell helper. Preserves MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH=50_000, file-size guards, binary-skip heuristic, and canonical output formats. CLI mode with --files/--no-git/--git-scope/--no-project. All 13 unit tests pass (covers file-not-found, binary-file, large-file, git-section composition with various flags). Verified output format with manual collectFileContents test. Task status set to in-progress.

Implemented types.ts, shared.ts, and shared.test.ts with complete type vocabulary, Bun.spawnSync wrapper, timestamp helpers, and model resolution with flag > config > constant > undefined precedence. All 24 unit tests pass covering resolveModel precedence branches, malformed config handling, timestamp formatting, and directory creation. No external dependencies.

Implemented capabilityGate and getBackend pure functions in gate.ts, with comprehensive unit tests in gate.test.ts. Both functions correctly check backend mode support and perform registry lookup without importing any concrete backends (maintains acyclic dependency graph). All tests pass: supported pairs return null, unsupported pairs return clear error messages, unknown names return undefined.

Created opencode.ts backend with invoke/parseOutput/parseJsonl functions and comprehensive test suite. All 18 tests pass. Implements delegate (kimi-k2.7-code) and review (qwen3.7-max) modes with prompt-based strategy. Handles --model override, tolerates bug #26855 in JSONL parsing, documents prompt-based (non-enforced) read-only review limitation.

codex sandbox permission issue: codex-run wrapper could not write outside task docs dir. Dev implemented relay-prompt.ts + relay-prompt.test.ts directly. Pure formatPrompt() formats both review and delegate prompts with neutral wording (no backend names), impure buildPromptFile() collects context + formats + writes to tmp. All 16 tests pass: review with/without focus, delegate with task, error on missing task, no backend naming, execution constraints verified. CLI entry tested: review and delegate modes create correct prompt files; delegate without task exits 1 with clear error.

Implemented codexBackend with full Backend interface: delegate (workspace-write + dangerous toggle), native review (uncommitted/base/commit flags), review prompt fallback (read-only), and image (gpt-image-2 PNG discovery + copy). Pure helpers: buildImagePrompt, extractGeneratedPngPath, findNewestPng all unit-tested. postRun hook handles PNG copy to opts.out with timestamp suffix. All 35 tests pass including argv structure, scope mapping, dangerous toggle, PNG path resolution, and mtime-based selection.

Implemented claudeBackend with delegate (prompt strategy) and review (native strategy) modes. Delegate builds argv: ['claude', '-p', promptText, '--output-format', 'json']. Review builds argv: ['claude', '-p', '/code-review <effort> [focus]'] with intelligent effort/focus parsing. parseOutput extracts .result → .text → .content[0].text → raw with JSON fallback. All 29 unit tests pass covering argv construction (delegate + review with effort/focus variants) and output parsing (valid JSON + plain text fallback + robustness).

Codex implemented backends/index.ts (BACKENDS registry), relay.ts (CLI entry with parseFlags, dispatch, gate, strategy routing, output contract), and relay.test.ts (15 tests covering all modes, gate rejection, strategy selection, flag parsing). All 154 tests in suite pass; no backend name branching detected in dispatch code. Output contract verified: final output written to last.md and printed to stdout.

Codex successfully created packages/relay/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and packages/relay/.codex-plugin/plugin.json (both v0.1.0 with matching canonical descriptions), and added relay entry to .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. Unable to write .agents/plugins/marketplace.json due to sandbox read-only restrictions; manually completed the Codex marketplace registration. All 4 JSON files valid, all 3 description strings match canonical, Codex interface contains all required phrases (codex/opencode/claude in shortDesc; delegate/review/image in longDesc). Both plugin versions = 0.1.0. All acceptance criteria now pass.

codex sandbox restriction: unable to write to packages/relay/ (PermissionError: Operation not permitted on apply_patch and direct writes). The working directory restriction prevented creating SKILL.md, commands/relay.md, and references/backends.md. Codex unreachable due to sandbox constraints.

Created all three required files: SKILL.md (220 lines with orchestration, smart-apply, report formats, model save-flow, image flow), commands/relay.md (9 lines with frontmatter and skill routing), references/backends.md (146 lines with per-CLI flags, #26855 caveat, and opencode install). All 154 unit tests pass. Acceptance criteria satisfied: frontmatter valid, command examples present for all modes, smart-apply policy and both report templates inlined, model save-to-config documented, install line matches packages/relay/skills/relay path.

codex added relay 0.1.0 entry to CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog format) and updated CLAUDE.md with relay bullet point in 'What This Is' section (covering delegation, two-layer/strategy design, capability matrix with image codex-only). Architecture tree added under packages/relay/ with full subtree documenting structure, distribution model, and version alignment. Verification passed: grep finds relay in both files, diff-scope confirms only CHANGELOG.md and CLAUDE.md modified, consistency read-through confirms accuracy with manifests.

Codex successfully created three backend alias command files (codex.md, opencode.md, claude.md) in packages/relay/commands/. Each file has valid YAML frontmatter with name, description, and argument-hint fields. codex includes 'image' in argument-hint, while opencode and claude do not. All files self-identify as aliases via 'alias for' text in description. Files defer to relay:relay skill with backend pre-fixed; no gate/strategy/report logic duplicated. Verification passed: frontmatter valid, grep 'alias for' matches all three, argument-hints correct per backend capabilities, files are thin-layer aliases only.

All 5 lenses fired (codex+reuse+simplification+efficiency+altitude); codex RAN (7 findings, not unreachable). Total ~25 findings. Fixed codex correctness/regression bugs: #1 review --files now defaults scope to custom-files (prompt strategy, no longer ignored); #2 bare scope refs (--scope main/abc123) normalized to codex review --base instead of falling through to wrong diff; #3 image PNG fallback now uses runStartedAt cutoff (threaded via InvokeOpts) instead of post-run Date.now()-1s; #4 postRun returns {ok,text} PostRunResult so image failures exit non-zero; #5 codex image with no prompt now fails fast before spawn. REJECTED codex #6/#7 (apply --model to codex/claude): contradict spec — cli-reference.md+backends.md explicitly say codex/claude model is unset, do not pass -m; only opencode resolves models. Claude lenses: applied RunResult dedup (single source in types.ts), dead tokens.length===0 guard removed, claude parseOutput early-guard cleanup, opencode dropped redundant resolveModel (trusts opts.model like codex/claude), mkdir uses run() not raw spawnSync, parseCsv helper deduped across 4 sites. Rejected resolveModel try/catch removal (injectable reader can throw — test relies on it), and broad refactors (GitScope alias, shell()/run merge, prompt write-then-read seam, parseJsonl deletion, collectGitInfo merge) as out-of-scope/risky for a final-review gate. Added tests for all new behaviors. VERIFICATION GREEN: 160 pass/0 fail; grep backend=== empty; all JSON valid; versions all 0.1.0; relay in both registries; 3 aliases route to skill; matrix holes fail fast. PLAN goal met.
